messages:
clara: Quick design pass: new routing editor row layout v3 uploaded to Figma. Goals: clearer priority affordance, better keyboard reorder, and friendlier validation copy. Link: https://redwood.design/f/routing-v3
dinesh: Looks cleaner. Suggest showing numeric rank (1,2,3) to avoid relying on color. Also increase divider contrast in light theme.
meredith: Copy nudge: inline error currently 'Overlap detected'. Propose 'Disabled 0— overlaps with rule #<n>. View conflict.' Add a small action link 'View conflict'.
paul: Keyboard: implement pick-up with Space then Arrow Up/Down to move rows. Ensure focus ring is visible and focus stays on the moved item. Announce new position via aria-live: 'Rule moved to position 2'.
a11y-bot: Reminder: touch targets >=44px and handle element should have aria-label 'Reorder rule'. Example: <button aria-label="Reorder rule" class="drag-handle" tabindex="0">☰</button>
clara: I'll flip handle to left, add numeric rank + chevron, swap toast copy to 'Cannot save — conflicts or missing fields. Click to review.' For the preview simulator: make 'Run sandbox' a secondary button next to Save, show small spinner while running, and emit telemetry event ui.policy.sandbox.run.
dinesh: Also include preview badges on matched rows: 'matched by #3' so users can map preview back to rules. Use aria-describedby to link badge to rule title for screen readers.
meredith: agree. Small accessibility add: when preview updates, include counts in polite region: 'Preview updated: 12 matches' so SR users are aware.
clara: Thanks — I'll update Figma and open the front-end PR with these items tomorrow and tag @design-review.
